catalog_description: Read-only Open Food Facts lookup and retailer-aware discovery with store filters for Publix, Sprouts, Costco, Aldi, and other OFF store tags.
description: Read-only Open Food Facts recipes for barcode product lookup, structured search, retailer-aware discovery, nutrition summaries, allergen and ingredient inspection, bounded comparison, category samples, and source posture checks.

novel_features.name: Barcode product lookup
novel_features.description: Fetch one Open Food Facts v3 product record with identity, labels, nutrition, ingredients, allergens, data-quality fields, image, and source URL.

novel_features.name: Retailer-aware structured search
novel_features.description: Filter bounded Open Food Facts v2 searches by generic stores_tags and purchase_places_tags, including Publix, Sprouts, Costco, Aldi, and other OFF tags.

novel_features.name: Nutrition summary
novel_features.description: Extract key nutriments, serving basis, Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score, source URL, and data-quality tags for one barcode.

novel_features.name: Ingredient and allergen inspection
novel_features.description: Report ingredient text, ingredient analysis tags, allergens, traces, additives, and voluntary-data caveats.

novel_features.name: Small product comparison
novel_features.description: Compare two to five barcode records while preserving per-barcode lookup errors and successful product output.

novel_features.name: Source and rate posture
novel_features.description: Report read-only auth, custom User-Agent configuration, documented rate limits, anti-bulk non-goals, and local configuration.
